name: haimunia-browser-check
description: On-demand real-Chromium smoke tests for things the jsdom test suite in ../../test/ can't reach: font loading, Service Worker lifecycle, real DOM event timing. Not part of the main app's dependency tree — install here only when you want to run these. See CHANGES.md in the project root for why this exists.

scripts.setup: npm install && npx playwright install chromium
